section.12: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

12.name_native: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

hadiths.text: It was narrated from 'Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Aqram that his father said:"I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and I used to see the whiteness of his armpits when he prostrated
